decision_id.description: Identifies this decision. Report its usage to `POST /v1/route/{decision_id}/usage`.

reason.description:
Why the first candidate leads. One of:

- `cheapest_confident`: the cheapest model confident enough to take the request
- `warm_cheapest`: the default, cheapest once its warm prompt cache is counted
- `escalated`: the default wasn't confident and every confident model costs more, so the cheapest of those
- `no_confident`: no model was confident enough, so the default
- `context_exceeds_config`: the request is longer than every model's context window, so the default
- `unrecognized_payload`: nothing to score in `body`, so the default
- `fallback:router_issue`: scoring failed, so the default
- `fallback:label_mismatch`: the router model can't score some of the router's models, so the default

candidates.description: The router's models, most recommended first. The first is its choice; move down the list if calling it fails.

model.description: The model's name on the router. Send it as `model` when you report usage.

model_id.description: The id to call the model by, as set on the router

confidence.description: The router model's score for this model on the request, from 0 to 1

effort.description: The reasoning effort the router picked for the model, to set on the request. Null leaves the request's own effort.

warnings.description: What you can act on about this request or its result. Usually empty.

code.description:
A stable code to branch on:

- `unreadable_request`: no task or conversation could be read from `body`, so the default is proposed
- `router_unavailable`: the router model didn't answer, so the default is proposed
- `label_mismatch`: the router model can't score some of the router's models, so the default is proposed
- `context_exceeds_models`: the request is longer than every model's context window; the default is proposed, but its provider will likely refuse it
- `no_session`: the request continues a conversation but no session id was found, so routing can't tell which model's cache is warm

message.example: This request continues a conversation, but no session id was found in `session_id` or `headers`, so routing can't see which model's cache is warm.
